The stand on the left has a blue painted top surface with a wavy pattern.
The stand on the right has a brown wood-grain patterned top surface.
Both stands have the same black metal frame design, including the treadle mechanism and footrest.
The top surface of the blue stand in photo 2 has a ruler printed on it.
The top surface of the brown stand in photo 3 has a glass insert in the center.
No sewing machines, motors, or accessories are visible in the photos.
